verdict.rationale: Session replay is clearly documented and lets PMs watch real user session recordings with synced DevTools context (posthog-docs-26, posthog-gh-8), but the evidence pack contains no mention of input masking or privacy protections applied by default to sensitive fields during replay. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of default input masking, opt-out/opt-in masking controls, and any independent confirmation that sensitive data is redacted in recordings.
